decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program builds on an established offer and has its own page, suggesting ongoing option value and low carrying costs while uncertainty remains.
The carpentry workshop leverages existing production know-how and has a dedicated page, so its option value outweighs the modest carrying cost.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's core and cheap to maintain while demand uncertainty resolves, even though it is only mentioned on the website.
Counseling for senior living is prominently shown on the home page and closely fits the firm's core, indicating a valuable option that is unlikely to be dropped.
The sheltered workshop retail shop carries higher ongoing costs and is only mentioned on the website, but its option value still justifies keeping it while the firm expands.
